official_isv_evidence.claim_boundary: Fixes the plural chapter head and its standard, non-standard, Q, PA, and computable-model scope.
Directly attests the international noun model and its six national cognates; plural morphology is editorial.
Directly attests aritmetika and its six national cognates; the genitive form is regular inflection.

rationale: Modeli aritmetiky is the shortest transparent Interslavic rendering of the Open Logic chapter head. It composes the established canon head model (OLISV-T0017) with the directly attested aritmetika component already used in OLISV-T0187 and OLISV-T0205. The genitive complement matches Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Czech, and Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian structure, while Bulgarian independently confirms the same semantic relation analytically. The phrase preserves the distinction between a plurality of structures and arithmetic as either language or theory.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The adjective can suggest models used for calculation or models having merely arithmetic properties, while the genitive construction more clearly preserves the source relation and dominates the comparison traditions.

evidence_locators.role: Chapter scope includes models of several arithmetic theories, not computational models alone

rejected_alternatives.reason: This is too narrow because the chapter includes structures, languages, standard and non-standard models, Q, PA, and computability rather than one single arithmetic theory.
